posts.subject: KnAWLeDGE's Test-Admin Application
posts.bodyHtml:
Hey guys! 



1. Information about myself.
My name is David and my in-game name is KnAWLeDGE, I live in the Netherlands and I speak Dutch and English, Dutch is my first language. My current age is 14 and I am 2 months off from my birthday (27-8), so I am almost 15 years young (please do not judge so harshly although I understand that younger age will generally mean less maturity), however, I have heard from Doo Doo that there were exceptions in the past for young admins who wrote extremely good applications, met other requirements, behaved much more maturely for their age and most importantly, had the support from the community.

2. Why I want to become an admin.
The reason I want to become Test-Admin for the Dream Knife server is that because when I'm online during the day and play on the server, some admins are unfortunately not available, busy, or away. I believe that if I became a Test-Admin, it will relieve the stress of other admins as I can guarantee that I will carry out necessary punishments and maintain the server as I am very active. I try my best to help the community by using !calladmin when there are rulebreakers but I assure you that the amount of !calladmin reports will go down dramatically when I become one of the Dream Team.

3. Playtime.
I have currently played on the Dream servers for around 4-5 months (mostly on the knife server but I am always available to help any other servers), over this period of time, I have accumalated around 9000 stamm points.


4. My hobbies.
My hobbies are going outside with friends, cooking and gaming ofcourse, one of the things that I do daily is talking with my friends and making new friends on TS3 (I am really active on TS3), my favourite games are CS:GO and GTA V, I have played Minecraft before but I do not enjoy it anymore.


5. Do you think of yourself as mature?
Even though I am very young and I appreciate the fact that the community will have the feeling of me admin abusing or being immature, but I assure you that I can be both entertaining and serious. When met with a serious situation, I am able to maintain calm and deal with the situation accordingly, if I am just generally playing on the server, I can assure that I bring a happy environment all around so people enjoy the experience of being on the Dream knife server as well as me having my fun too!

6. My experience with being an administrator.
I do have experience as an admin, I owned my own CS:GO servers (with Source Mod), the community had around 20± online players a day and it was a retake server. I have also owned a Minecraft server with 50-60 online players and with a record of 130, at one time we hit 50.000 users on our server and 5.000 on our forum. I have a YouTube channel too where you can see that I did own the server:



7. This is a timetable showing the times of which I am available.
[Bild]


Click here if the image does not work correctly: Click me! :D

8. User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
First, I would ask if they are friends, and if they both answer with 'Yes' I would ignore it, I would not completely ignore it because there is a limit.
If they are not friends, I would add User 1 and talk to him why he is insulting User 2, if he continuous after we talked about it, I would warn him (Maximum 3 warns), if he still does not stop, I would kick him once and if he still continuous I would ban him for 30 minutes.



9. My strengths.
My strengths would be that I am able to fluently speak both Dutch and English, so I am able to help players who come from those respective nationalities but I understand that it is a German/English server so I will have to communicate with them via steam or with Dream's TS3 server. I am also able to maintain and control a large base of players, when there are a lot of players online on the server. Additionally, I have lots of experiences as an admin on multiple platforms so I can use that and my knowledge of the rules of Dream along with my language skills, I will be able to maintain order within Dream servers.


10. My weaknesses.
My weaknesses are that although I am rather fluent in English, I do sometimes stutter a bit when looking for the right words to use and of course, the fact that I do not meet Dream's age requirement to become an admin. Another weakness is that my of German is lacking, although I do understand it a bit sometimes but it's still pretty hard to understand for me.

11. Conclusion / Closing remark.
I would love to become an admin, I meet every requirement except for the age requirement and that I don't speak German that well. I see many rule breakers and I want to get the server as clean as possible :). I will not abuse my powers in any way and I will value every player the same.


Thanks for reading my application <3.
- David.

Helloooo Knawledge, yet another person willing to help out the Admin Team which I am very pleased of 😄 .


As alwaays, starting with the Pros:
👍 - You are definitely a nice, warm-hearted person.
👍 - You definitely have the majority of the knife community's support!
👍 - Your reasons to join the Admin Team are very reasonable - there is a lack of knife admins at the moment.
👍 - You are indeed very active.
👍 - You try your best to help the team by !calladmin or simply reporting them to me which is very helpful.
👍 - You are more or less well known within the knife community as you are very active, talkative and nice thus, gaining their support.
👍 - You know the rules well as you try your best to encourage rule breakers to stop rule-breaking.
👍 - You are very active on both TS3 and the Dream forums.
👍 - You seem to have a very large amount of experience of being an admin of some kind which is nice.


However:
👎 - Although you are a nice guy, your humorous side can sometimes extravagate and therefore, maybe portray a reckless/kiddy side of you.
👎 - Sometimes, you do let yourself get out of hand and sometimes make slightly offensive comments which does show you're still maturing but I'm sure you'll be able to stop this after you understand and accumulate authority.
👎 - There is a slight risk of admin abusing as you may get a bit mad when you are met with rule breakers and your ability to remain calm when dealing with situations may be lacking.


Well, as you can see, the pros heavily outweigh the cons and I have my faith in you that, coupled with your extensive past of administration and your generally nice attitude, I believe that you will be able to mature through having the admin powers and understand what situations are entitled to being fun around and which situations in where you have to act mature.


For me, it is a YES.

~Doo Doo

Thank you @Doo Doo for your reply :D. I can promise you that I will never abuse any powers.


- David.

Hey KnAWLeDGE,


unfortunately, we've decided to reject your application as an test-admin.
Although your application is well written and you quite active on the knife server, you are simply too young for this position. It is true that under certain circumstances, we make exceptions sometimes but these only happen on rare occasions. I'm sorry that we can't make one for you.


Being 14 years old obviously makes us question your maturity and we currently don't want to take any risks regarding potential admin abuse.


Thank you for trying to help the Dream Community.
